basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE individual approval-candidate mascot asset for Pofis. Use the canonical Pofi image as the identity reference. Preserve the SAME particular kitten, never redesign it. Match the canonical image: oversized broad round warm ivory head, large triangular ears with lavender inner ear, ONE large curved ivory forehead curl matching its direction and silhouette, widely spaced deep dark purple oval eyes with small highlights, tiny dark triangular nose and understated cat mouth, pale pink cheeks, two fine lavender whiskers each side, very short chubby seated body, lavender shaded paw tips, one plump lavender tail curving along viewer LEFT, lavender V lanyard with small white rounded rectangular badge matching the canonical reference. Identity fur #FFF7F1, lavender #CFC3E6, ink #2B2240, blush #FFDDEA. Preserve head/body proportions and ear/eye shape. Premium softly shaded matte pastel illustration, gentle plush volume as reference, no plastic shine, no hyperrealism, no different cartoon style. Calm warm office companion, subtle expressions, never exaggerated or distressed. Centered whole figure with ALL ears/curl/tail/feet/props visible, square 1024x1024-style composition, 8-12% transparent padding, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, no room, no floor plane, no background color, no checkerboard drawn into image. Restrained small office props only as specified. FOUR limbs total: exactly two forelegs and two hind feet, no duplicate paws or human fingers, no floating objects. Badge remains attached visibly and unobscured. No extra text, labels, caption, UI, watermark, stars/hearts/confetti. Deliver exactly ONE clean isolated asset, not a sheet/collage. Task-specific change:
